optimization_plan.action: 把招标文件、合同公告里的付款条件、结算口径、履约期限抽成 contract_payment_condition、settlement_basis、payment_trigger 三个字段。
optimization_plan.reason: 8 条记录已经出现“预算为测算金额、按实际发生结算”等付款/结算条款。

optimization_plan.action: 继续把优惠率、详见征集文件、服务范围限额、单价报价从成交总金额中拆出，框架协议默认进入补数或复核建议。
optimization_plan.reason: 5 条框架/报价语义记录不适合直接参与预算差异高风险比较。

optimization_plan.action: 为合同、验收、支付、整改公告建立可配置关键词模板，按项目编号、包号、采购单位和供应商自动生成检索任务。
optimization_plan.reason: 第六批生成 61 个待发现项，覆盖 acceptance、payment、contract、rectification。

optimization_plan.area: special fund policy to payment chain
optimization_plan.action: 专项资金政策字段继续补预算科目、资金去向、禁止用途、绩效期限，并预留支付/凭证核验字段。
optimization_plan.reason: 8 条专项资金记录已经结构化，适合下一步接支付和凭证链路。

optimization_plan.action: 审计报告解读、专项调查、工作方法类来源要保留 evidence weight，低权重内容只生成复核建议或知识参考。
optimization_plan.reason: 本批审计来源层级分布为 {"rectification_progress":8,"formal_audit_report":4}。

optimization_plan.action: Connect the queue to scheduled official-site crawlers and persist matched, not_found, parse_failed and manual_review states.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 6 queue items can now be consumed deterministically; production needs scheduling, retries and reviewer workflow.

optimization_plan.action: Promote settlement_basis, payment_trigger and payment_deadline into procurement-chain detail and report views.
optimization_plan.reason: Tender and contract payment terms explain why budget amounts must not be treated as actual payments.

optimization_plan.action: Use required_payment_data and required_voucher_data to drive payment and voucher import checklists.
optimization_plan.reason: Policy records should become concrete follow-up data requests instead of isolated fiscal indicators.

top_findings.summary: Multi-package and electronic marketplace amounts are treated as review hints, not strong violation conclusions.
Special-fund and final-account rows require downstream payment, voucher and performance evidence.

optimization_plan.action: Add province-level source profiles for non-Jiangsu official procurement and audit pages, including administrative code mapping, publisher aliases and amount-unit defaults.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 8 introduced 湖北省 and central-unit procurement examples; the Jiangsu-only normalization layer should not misclassify cross-region official records.

optimization_plan.action: Model electronic marketplace records separately for unit price, quantity, delivery item and aggregate order value before budget comparison.
optimization_plan.reason: Electronic marketplace成交公告 often mixes small order amounts, item quantities and device unit prices.

optimization_plan.action: Extend PDF table extraction from budget PDFs to final-account PDFs, preserving page number, table title, subject row and performance target rows.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 8 added江苏财政厅部门决算 PDF sources; these are useful for comparing budget, final account and performance evidence.

optimization_plan.action: Keep专项审计调查 and工作动态 as review_recommended or knowledge_reference unless a formal result公告 or整改结果 document is linked.
optimization_plan.reason: Audit work updates provide useful leads but remain lower evidence strength than formal result公告.

top_findings.summary: Electronic marketplace unit prices are review-only unless order totals are present.
Department final-account PDF rows preserve table, subject and performance locators.

optimization_plan.area: real crawler scheduling and review workflow
optimization_plan.action: Persist crawler statuses and add scheduled retry batches for matched, not_found, parse_failed and manual_review queue states.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 9 can run deterministic registry-backed discovery; production needs scheduling, retry windows and reviewer ownership.

optimization_plan.action: Promote source_region_scope and purchaser_region_code into import preview, detail and report views.
optimization_plan.reason: Central and cross-province sources must not inherit Jiangsu-only region assumptions.

optimization_plan.action: Require order_total_amount before comparing marketplace purchases to budget totals; unit prices remain review-only.
optimization_plan.reason: Electronic marketplace records often expose unit price and quantity separately from the order total.

top_findings.summary: Live-search candidate sources are tracked separately from stable registry snapshot results.
Procurement intention records create follow-up discovery tasks and do not form strong procurement findings.
Fiscal expenditure standard and zero-based budget policy records are structured as context and follow-up data requirements.

optimization_plan.action: Run live crawler in sampling mode against 10 to 20 queue items per batch and persist provider attempt diagnostics separately from stable baselines.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 10 added official provider registry and candidate index sources; live web volatility should not corrupt deterministic regression evidence.

optimization_plan.action: Model procurement intention as a pre-announcement stage and link it forward to announcement, award, contract and acceptance records by project name and purchaser.
optimization_plan.reason: Procurement intentions expose planned budget but not final project numbers or suppliers, so they should create follow-up discovery tasks rather than risk findings.

optimization_plan.action: Add batch-month, product category and manufacturer dimensions for central batch awards before budget comparison.
optimization_plan.reason: Centralized batch awards aggregate multiple product lots and should not be treated as one local single-project award.

optimization_plan.action: Keep audit work updates and method references outside the risk candidate pool unless linked to formal audit results or rectification reports.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 10 low-weight audit examples show useful context but insufficient evidence for substantive violations.

top_findings.summary: Procurement intention records only create downstream discovery tasks.
Centralized batch totals are review context; lot amounts are the comparison granularity.
Fiscal policy records generate follow-up data requirements without risk conclusions.

optimization_plan.action: Keep procurement intention records in pre_announcement stage and generate downstream discovery tasks for announcement, award, contract, acceptance, and payment sources.
optimization_plan.reason: Intentions are planning disclosures; planned budget should not become budget variance or split-procurement evidence.

optimization_plan.action: Use batch_month, product category, manufacturer, model, and lot fields before allowing batch lot amounts into amount consistency checks.
optimization_plan.reason: Central batch totals aggregate many products and should not be compared as a single project award.

optimization_plan.action: Run live crawler on a fixed 10-20 item sample with a stable seed and persist only live_crawl_summary/live_crawler_results.
optimization_plan.reason: Network volatility should be visible but must not change deterministic accepted baselines.

optimization_plan.action: Carry fiscal policy rows into required budget indicator, performance target, payment detail, and voucher abstract checklists.
optimization_plan.reason: Policy disclosures are context and data requirements, not direct audit findings.

top_findings.summary: Procurement notices expose contract terms and policy flags; conclusions stay supplemental.
Fiscal policy rows generate supplemental evidence checklists for internal sample trials.

optimization_plan.area: contract terms and government purchase service modeling
optimization_plan.action: Add first-class fields for contract performance period, government purchase service flag, joint-bid flag, SME policy, and credit-financing policy.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 12 procurement notices expose compliance terms that are currently only stored as loose sample fields.

optimization_plan.action: Turn budget performance and special fund policy text into budget indicator, performance target, payment, voucher, and disclosure-quality evidence checklists.
optimization_plan.reason: Fiscal policy sources are useful for next-data planning but should not become risk conclusions without internal records.

optimization_plan.area: audit project plan and special survey disposition
optimization_plan.action: Model audit_project_plan separately from special_audit_survey and audit_result_feedback with lower default evidence weight.
optimization_plan.reason: Project plans and surveys guide collection scope but do not establish confirmed violations.

optimization_plan.action: Extend crawler from URL-level matching to related public disclosure chains: procurement notice -> result -> contract -> acceptance -> payment/rectification.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 12 queue remains mostly supplemental because notices are not automatically chained to downstream disclosures.

top_findings.summary: Contract and procurement policy terms are preserved as supplemental review fields.
Fiscal policy rows generate supplemental evidence checklists.

optimization_plan.area: contract policy terms and chain discovery
optimization_plan.action: Persist contract performance period, government purchase service, joint-bid, SME, credit-financing and procurement policy notes as first-class procurement fields.
optimization_plan.reason: These terms explain the public procurement context and should drive supplemental review rather than high-risk conclusions.

optimization_plan.action: Promote chain discovery metadata into the crawler UI and continue from announcement to award, contract, acceptance, payment and rectification candidates.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 13 shows queue metadata can make public chain gaps explainable and reproducible.

optimization_plan.action: Keep fiscal policy records as next-data checklists for budget indicators, performance targets, payments and vouchers.
optimization_plan.reason: Policy text is useful for collection scope, but not a standalone violation basis.

top_findings.summary: Fulfillment acceptance and payment terms are preserved as supplemental evidence fields.
Fiscal policy rows generate next-data checklists for budget, performance, payment and voucher evidence.

optimization_plan.action: Promote fulfillment acceptance management into the procurement chain view and require contract performance evidence, acceptance documents and payment disclosures as separate follow-up targets.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 14 official sources show acceptance management policy can explain chain gaps without treating missing public payment data as a violation.

optimization_plan.action: Model transfer payment monitoring, township budget performance, debt and current-account policies as supplemental checklists for budget indicators, performance targets, payment details and voucher abstracts.
optimization_plan.reason: Fiscal policy texts are useful to define later evidence needs, but they are not standalone audit findings.

optimization_plan.action: Use contract period, settlement basis, payment trigger and acceptance policy terms to prioritize crawler discovery from announcement to award, contract, acceptance and payment candidates.
optimization_plan.reason: The next test should measure whether policy terms improve candidate matching confidence instead of only increasing sample volume.

top_findings.summary: Fulfillment acceptance and payment conditions are preserved as chain evidence fields.
Fiscal policy records generate supplemental checklist requirements only.

optimization_plan.area: fulfillment acceptance and payment condition topic
optimization_plan.action: Keep acceptance plan, acceptance opinion, archive locator, contract performance period and payment trigger in one procurement-chain topic for reports and front-end chain views.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 15 records show acceptance and payment clauses explain public-chain gaps without supporting a substantive violation conclusion by themselves.

optimization_plan.action: Promote provider query terms, search URL, candidate URLs, candidate stage scores and not-found reasons into the public discovery queue output.
optimization_plan.reason: A not-found result needs enough diagnostic evidence to explain whether the crawler searched the right project, package, purchaser, supplier and target stage.

optimization_plan.action: Keep transfer-payment monitoring, township performance, debt/current-account and expenditure-standard policies as next-data checklists for budget indicators, performance targets, payments and vouchers.
optimization_plan.reason: Policy text is useful to define missing internal evidence, but it should not become a risk finding without payment and voucher proof.

top_findings.summary: Service period, acceptance and maintenance clauses are preserved for downstream chain discovery.
Fiscal performance and special-fund policy rows generate next-data requirements only.

optimization_plan.area: service period acceptance and maintenance evidence
optimization_plan.action: Add first-class fields for service_time, maintenance_period, warranty_period, acceptance_standard and acceptance_result_locator so award notices with service periods do not lose downstream evidence requirements.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 16 procurement sources contain service periods, maintenance windows and acceptance descriptions that are distinct from payment terms.

optimization_plan.action: Split fiscal policy supplemental checklists by budget indicator, project performance target, quarterly performance monitoring, payment progress and voucher attachment evidence.
optimization_plan.reason: Fiscal and audit sources describe performance monitoring and budget management as process controls, not standalone risk conclusions.

optimization_plan.action: Treat formal audit results and rectification disclosures as risk candidates, while work updates, method references and audit knowledge only produce review or knowledge-reference records.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 16 audit sources mix formal result announcements with work dynamics; evidence strength must continue to drive disposition.

top_findings.summary: Service period, maintenance, warranty and acceptance evidence are preserved for downstream chain discovery.
Fiscal performance policy rows generate next-data checklist requirements only.

optimization_plan.area: service period maintenance and acceptance evidence
optimization_plan.action: Keep service_period, maintenance_period, warranty_period, acceptance_standard and acceptance_result_locator separate from payment terms in import, chain closure and reports.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 17 official procurement sources expose service and warranty clauses that are downstream evidence requirements rather than payment conditions.

optimization_plan.action: Report budget indicator, project performance target, quarterly monitoring, payment progress and voucher attachment coverage separately.
optimization_plan.reason: Fiscal performance policies describe follow-up evidence needed for internal sample trials, not standalone violations.

optimization_plan.action: Use project code, package number, supplier, service period and acceptance clauses to score contract, acceptance and payment candidates.
optimization_plan.reason: URL and title matching alone leaves too many not_found or manual_review queue items.

top_findings.summary: Complaint handling, correction and supervision notices are preserved as exception evidence and do not create strong conclusions without internal evidence.
Fiscal procurement supervision policy rows generate follow-up data checklists only.

optimization_plan.action: Add first-class fields for complaint decision number, handling result, false material flag, award invalidation, rebid requirement, correction notice and penalty subject.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 18 official sources show that complaint handling and supervision notices are evidence for review workflows, not direct audit conclusions.

optimization_plan.action: Extend crawler chain discovery from correction and complaint notices to invalidation, rebid, contract, acceptance, payment and rectification candidates.
optimization_plan.reason: A complaint may change the procurement result, but the next public evidence is often a correction notice or rebid announcement.

optimization_plan.action: Persist legal basis, decision number, affected package, paragraph index and locator hash in report-ready evidence blocks.
optimization_plan.reason: Complaint decisions require precise source positioning before they can be used in a PoC delivery report.

top_findings.summary: Complaint, supervision, correction and rebid public notices are review-only until downstream evidence is complete.
Fiscal supervision policy rows generate follow-up evidence checklists only.

optimization_plan.action: Keep complaint decision number, issue summary, handling result, false material flag, award invalidation, rebid requirement, correction notice, penalty subject and affected package as first-class procurement fields.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 19 official notices show these fields are needed to explain review status without overstating a violation.

optimization_plan.action: Continue crawler expansion from complaint or supervision notice to correction, award invalidation, rebid, new award, contract, acceptance, payment and rectification candidates.
optimization_plan.reason: The public evidence chain changes after a complaint, so downstream stages must be discovered before any risk candidate is formed.

optimization_plan.action: Persist legal basis, article, decision paragraph, affected package and handling result locator hash in report evidence blocks.
optimization_plan.reason: Formal PoC reports need exact decision-location evidence for manual review.

top_findings.summary: Penalty, complaint and supervision notices are review-only until downstream contract, acceptance, payment and internal voucher evidence is complete.
Fiscal supervision policy rows generate follow-up evidence checklists only.

optimization_plan.action: Add structured penalty status, penalty basis, penalty duration, supplier disqualification scope and malicious collusion flags instead of storing all supervision results as generic text.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 20 sources show supervision penalties and complaint decisions have different downstream review needs.

optimization_plan.action: Let crawler search penalty follow-up, correction, rebid, new award, contract, acceptance, payment and rectification by decision number plus penalty subject.
optimization_plan.reason: Penalty announcements alone are review evidence; downstream chain closure is needed before risk candidates.

optimization_plan.action: Add a dedicated penalty and supervision handling block showing rejected, established, false material, collusion, penalty subject and manual review status.
optimization_plan.reason: PoC users need to distinguish administrative penalty clues from audit conclusions.

top_findings.summary: Administrative penalty, credit restriction and complaint notices are review-only until downstream evidence is complete.
Fiscal policy rows generate follow-up evidence checklists only.

optimization_plan.action: Keep penalty decision number, legal basis, penalty period, market restriction scope, penalty subject and credit repair status as first-class procurement fields.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 21 sources show administrative penalties need different evidence weight and follow-up handling from rejected complaints.

optimization_plan.action: Search penalty follow-up, credit restriction, credit repair, re-participation, contract, acceptance and payment by decision number plus penalty subject.
optimization_plan.reason: Penalty notices alone remain review evidence; downstream closure is required before any risk candidate.

optimization_plan.action: Separate supervision penalty and credit constraint reporting from complaint handling, with evidence weights and manual review status.
optimization_plan.reason: PoC delivery should not give complaint rejection and administrative penalty the same weight.

top_findings.summary: Complaint adjudication notices are allegations and handling outcomes until remedy, contract, acceptance, payment and voucher evidence is complete.
Complaint adjudication policy rows generate follow-up evidence checklists only.

optimization_plan.action: Add structured allegation_type, allegation_outcome, confirmed_fact_flag and remedy_action fields so allegations are not treated as confirmed violations.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 22 sources mix false-material allegations, SME-policy allegations, bid-document defects and rejected complaints in the same document family.

optimization_plan.action: Generate correction, award invalidation, rebid, new award, contract, acceptance and payment discovery tasks based on complaint outcome and affected package.
optimization_plan.reason: Complaint decisions need downstream remedy evidence before any strong risk candidate.

optimization_plan.action: Add a complaint adjudication outcome block separating established, partly established, rejected and evidence-insufficient decisions.
optimization_plan.reason: PoC delivery needs to explain why complaint documents are review-only rather than audit conclusions.

top_findings.summary: Complaint adjudication notices are allegations and handling outcomes until remedy, contract, acceptance, payment and voucher evidence is complete.
Complaint adjudication policy rows generate follow-up evidence checklists only.

optimization_plan.action: Add structured allegation_type, allegation_outcome, confirmed_fact_flag and remedy_action fields so allegations are not treated as confirmed violations.
optimization_plan.reason: Round 23 sources mix false-material allegations, SME-policy allegations, bid-document defects and rejected complaints in the same document family.

optimization_plan.action: Generate correction, award invalidation, rebid, new award, contract, acceptance and payment discovery tasks based on complaint outcome and affected package.
optimization_plan.reason: Complaint decisions need downstream remedy evidence before any strong risk candidate.

optimization_plan.action: Add a complaint adjudication outcome block separating established, partly established, rejected and evidence-insufficient decisions.
optimization_plan.reason: PoC delivery needs to explain why complaint documents are review-only rather than audit conclusions.
